name: Backlash
description: The ghost's own abilities can be turned against it — as when the Ghostbusters reversed the energy flow of Gozer's dimensional portal.

name: Defense Cracker
description: A specific object, weapon or formula that ignores the spook's defenses (a wooden stake or sunlight against a vampire's physical immunity).

name: Inhibitor
description: An object that keeps the monster at bay or from moving, regardless of its abilities (a proper pentagram against a demon, a cross against a vampire).

name: Motivator
description: The spook's energy comes from an external source; destroy that source and the entity stops (a magic stove powering a tide of zombies).

name: Secret Fear
description: Something that terrorizes the ghost. Discover and confront it and the specter flees to another dimension, loses its powers, or is profoundly weakened.

name: Secret Goal
description: The ghost has a goal it cannot reveal. Observe, research or reconstruct it, accomplish the goal for the ghost, and it dissipates happily.
